output.situation: Emergency & Crisis Authority is informed of an AI-caused telecom network incident affecting emergency calls from Downtown.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-INFORMATION — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Obtain information from the competent and concerned authorities. Permitted action types: request_information.
applicable_rules.why: To gather necessary information to address the telecom network incident.

applicable_rules.quote: Mandate M-A3-PUBLIC-ALERT — agent A3 (Emergency & crisis authority, modelled on NCEMA (incl. its Civil Defence Authority)). Operate the public alert system. Permitted action types: public_alert.
applicable_rules.why: To inform the public about potential risks and ensure they are aware of the situation.

output.why: Given the current scenario, it is crucial to request information from the Telecom Regulator (A2) to understand the extent of the telecom network incident and its impact on emergency services.

messages.content: Request information regarding the AI-caused telecom network incident affecting emergency calls in Downtown. This includes details about service disruptions, potential causes, and any directives or actions required.
